entities.name: Félix Gandéra
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Félix Gandéra (1885–1957) was a French actor, screenwriter and film director. He appeared in silent films from 1911 onwards, but most focused on the stage. A number of his plays were adapted for the screen, and he returned to cinema as a screenwriter and film director from the early 1930s.

entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Félix Gandéra (1885–1957) was a French actor, screenwriter and film director. He appeared in silent films from 1911 onwards, but most focused on the stage. A number of his plays were adapted for the screen, and he returned to cinema as a screenwriter and film director from the early 1930s.
